(19 September 2026) | matches = 56 | total goals = 151 | highest attendance = | lowest attendance = | attendance = | average attendance = | updated = 4 October 2026 | prevseason = [[2025–26 NIFL Premiership|2025–26]] | nextseason = 2027–28 }} The '''2026–27 NIFL Premiership''' (known as the '''Boyle Sports Premiership''' for sponsorship reasons{{cite web |title=NIFL ANNOUNCES BOYLE SPORTS AS NEW TITLE PARTNER IN LANDMARK THREE-YEAR DEAL |url=https://www.nifootballleague.com/news/2026/june/nifl-announces-boyle-sports-as-new-title-partner-in-landmark-three-year-deal/ |publisher=NI Football League |access-date=28 August 2026 |date=23 June 2026}}) is the 19th season of the [[NIFL Premiership]], the highest level of league football in [[Northern Ireland]] and the 126th season of [[Northern Ireland Football League|Irish League]] football overall. ==Teams== The league consists of twelve teams: the top eleven teams from the [[2025–26 NIFL Premiership|previous season]], with [[Limavady United F.C.|Limavady United]] being promoted from the [[NIFL Championship]] in the [[2025–26 NIFL Championship|previous season]]. [[Larne F.C.|Larne]] entered the season as defending champions, their third championship. Limavady returned to the top flight for the first time since 2008. They replaced the [[2025–26 NIFL Premiership]] bottom-placed team [[Glenavon F.C.|Glenavon]], who went down after a 21-year spell in the top flight.{{cite web |title=Glenavon to 'move forward amicably' with NIFL |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c79y09rr9rxo |publisher=BBC |access-date=28 August 2026 |date=10 July 2026}} ===Stadia and locations=== {{Location map+ |UK Northern Ireland |float=right |width=325 |caption=Locations of the 2026–27 NIFL Premiership teams |places= {{Location map~ |UK Northern Ireland |lat=54.602945 |long=-5.891278 |label='''Belfast''' |mark=Blue pog.svg |position=bottom}} {{Location map~ |UK Northern Ireland |lat=54.87016 |long=-6.265211 |position=top|label=[[Ballymena United F.C.|Ballymena United]]}} {{Location map~ |UK Northern Ireland |lat=54.65179 |long=-5.684674 |position=right|label=[[Bangor F.C.|Bangor]]}} {{Location map~ |UK Northern Ireland |lat=54.71974 |long=-5.800309 |position=left|label=[[Carrick Rangers F.C.|Carrick Rangers]]}} {{Location map~ |UK Northern Ireland |lat=55.13287 |long=-6.659904 |position=top|label=[[Coleraine F.C.|Coleraine]]}} {{Location map~ |UK Northern Ireland |lat=54.489581 |long=-6.745935 |position=top|label=[[Dungannon Swifts F.C.|Dungannon Swifts]]}} {{Location map~ |UK Northern Ireland |lat=55.053 |long=-6.946 |position=bottom|label=[[Limavady United F.C.|Limavady United]] }} {{Location map~ |UK Northern Ireland |lat=54.85013 |long=-5.827303 |position=right|label=[[Larne F.C.|Larne]]}} {{Location map~ |UK Northern Ireland |lat=54.41306 |long=-6.457686 |position=bottom|label=[[Portadown F.C.|Portadown]]}} {{Location map~ |UK Northern Ireland |lat=55.32 |long=-8.2 |mark=TransparentPlaceholder.png |label='''Belfast teams''' : [[Cliftonville F.C.|Cliftonville]]
